reuse.why: Changes the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount helper and routes the remaining inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, updateActions, getScheduledAmount) through it.

duplication.why: All copies of the range rule are removed; call sites such as updateActions and schedule-template still keep their own null/number/range dispatch around the helper, which getScheduledAmount already provides.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the shared module both server and client schedule code already use for it.

scope.why: Touches the helper, the call sites that bypassed it, comments that described the old midpoint rule and a release note.

maintainability.why: One function now defines the expected amount of a ranged schedule for every path, so the next rule change is a one-line edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every former inline midpoint (schedule-template.ts, schedules/app.ts updateActions, getScheduledAmount) now calls getExpectedScheduleAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicate remains; the old copies are replaced by calls to the helper.

one_place.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used directly or via getScheduledAmount by schedule-template, forecast, schedules app, preview and client components.
